# PN2252 — Amy Coney Barrett — Supreme Court of the United States 116th Congress (2019-2020)

## Nomination

Hide Overview

## Description

* Amy Coney Barrett, of Indiana, to be an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States, vice Ruth Bader Ginsburg, deceased.

## Organization

* Supreme Court of the United States

## Latest Action

* 10/26/2020 - Confirmed by the Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 52 - 48. Record Vote Number: 224.

## Date Received from President

* 09/29/2020

## Committee

* Senate Judiciary

## Actions: PN2252 — 116th Congress (2019-2020)

| Date | Senate Actions |
| --- | --- |
| 10/26/2020 | Confirmed by the Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 52 - 48. Record Vote Number: 224. |
| 10/25/2020 | Cloture invoked in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 51 - 48. Record Vote Number: 222. |
| 10/23/2020 | Motion by Senator Schumer to recommit to Senate Committee on the Judiciary tabled in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 53 - 44. Record Vote Number: 219. |
| 10/23/2020 | Motion by Senator Schumer to indefinitely postpone tabled in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 53 - 44. Record Vote Number: 218. |
| 10/23/2020 | Cloture motion presented in Senate. |
| 10/23/2020 | Motion to proceed to executive session to consideration of nomination agreed to in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 51 - 46. Record Vote Number: 217. |
| 10/22/2020 | Placed on Senate Executive Calendar. Calendar No. 890. |
| 10/22/2020 | Reported by Senator Graham, Committee on the Judiciary, without printed report. |
| 10/22/2020 | Committee on the Judiciary. Ordered to be reported favorably. |
| 10/15/2020 | Committee on the Judiciary. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 116-637. |
| 10/14/2020 | Committee on the Judiciary. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 116-637. |
| 10/13/2020 | Committee on the Judiciary. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 116-637. |
| 10/12/2020 | Committee on the Judiciary. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 116-637. |
| 09/29/2020 | Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. |
